author: claude:factory
source_detail: A club's home-run rate is concentrated in two or three hitters far more than its run scoring is, so an absence hits the home-run market harder than the moneyline. Same card, different instrument.
thesis: Home runs come from a handful of players, so one of them being out of the card changes the home-run market much more than it changes who wins. The lineup bot reads the same card and spends the information on the market where it matters least.

entry.when: At T-90m or T-30m, once the card is posted, sum the missing occupants' season home runs per plate appearance against their replacements', requiring 100 plate appearances for both. ASSUMPTION, STATED: 0.010 of summed home-run rate across the card is worth about 0.11 expected home runs, which is about 2.2 cents on an at-the-money home-run market. Enter when net edge after the real ask and the half fee is at least 1.0c.

wrong_if: Result inside plus or minus 1 cent on 300 or more entries.
Overlap of entered sides with SF207 above 0.5, in which case only one of the two should hold a slot.
The home-run family turns out to be per-PLAYER rather than per-team, in which case an absent player's market simply does not settle and the spec is void.
notes: PAIRED-TESTABLE against lineup. || RANKED LOW BECAUSE IT MAY BE A NEAR-COPY OF SF207 - same card, same reasoning, different market - and mailbox 012's warning about ten near-copies applies to it more than to anything else in this list. It is listed as a RESERVE, not as one of the ten. || Cost bar and ask depth are MEASURED off this project's own recorded tape, not assumed - src/mlb_cost.py, median over every two-sided touch recorded 2026-08-18 to 2026-09-03 between 5c and 95c, with the fee taken at that series' own rate from the census. Both sides of the real touch, never the mid. || Exit is HOLD TO SETTLEMENT on every spec here, deliberately. Mailbox 012: tennis measured exits properly and holding beat selling early in 5 of 5 mentalities, and mlb's own 81-configuration sweep had every stop-loss doing worse than holding. So the exit question is closed and nothing below varies it. These are ENTRY specs only.
